intent: Use separate date headers and a generous blank gutter between the two file records. No line, identical handle or shared highlight may imply a single continuing author.
source:
**Frame:** Split dossier panel. Left: the anonymous 20 April file. Right: the 8 May incidental file. A wide gutter and separate timestamps prevent visual continuity.

**Action:** Two sparse traces form a pattern only for the reader.

**Caption:**
> NOT THE SAME RUN. NOT YET A CONVERSATION.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — distinction follows the source record; juxtaposition is project analysis.
title: Two writes with no continuity asserted
